hook: The AI gave you a 7-step framework when you just needed a straight answer.
caption:
The AI gave you a 7-step framework when you just needed a straight answer.

This happens because AI doesn't know if you're a "walk me through it" person or a "just tell me the answer" person.

So it defaults to thorough. Which reads as exhausting.

There are actually 8 distinct thinking styles that change what a "good" AI response looks like:

→ Some people need the conclusion first, then the reasoning
→ Some need the context before they can trust the conclusion
→ Some want bullet points
→ Some find bullet points cold and need full sentences
→ Some want to be challenged
→ Some need to feel heard before they can absorb new information

None of these are wrong. But generic AI treats them all the same.

BootFile maps your thinking style once — then every response you get is calibrated to how YOUR brain actually processes information.

No more re-prompting. No more "can you make that shorter." No more getting a dissertation when you asked a yes-or-no question.

The AI doesn't get smarter. It just finally knows who it's talking to.
